desc_en: KT board (PVC foam board) sheets for mounting printed graphics, exhibition display boards and indoor signage. Thickness, sheet size and pricing are confirmed per quotation.
desc_zh: KT板（PVC发泡板）室内展示板材，适用于印刷画面裱贴、展览展示板和室内标识。厚度、尺寸与价格按询价确认。

detail_en.artwork: Please provide print-ready artwork, finished dimensions, quantity, required board thickness and destination. File dimensions and bleed can be checked before production.
detail_en.brief: Please specify the board thickness, sheet size, quantity, printing and mounting requirements, packing requirements and destination country or region.
detail_en.caveat: The sheet sizes above are maximums; panels are trimmed to your finished dimensions. 10mm board is currently available only from the Haiyan, Zhejiang partner factory serving the Jiangsu-Zhejiang-Shanghai-Anhui region, so confirm the production origin and timing when ordering 10mm. Density, minimum order quantity and pricing are not listed on this page: they are confirmed against the actual specification of each order, so please state your required specification when enquiring. KT board is positioned as an indoor display material; suitability for long-term outdoor use must be confirmed for the intended environment.
delivery: Production and dispatch timing confirmed per order
Sea freight to Australian main ports is around 40 days as a reference
Photos of the finished boards and the export packing are sent for your confirmation before dispatch
Standard packing: flat stacked sheets; alternative packing can be confirmed per order
highlights: Flat surface suited to mounting printed graphics
Lightweight rigid sheet, easy to handle and install
Standard 5mm; full sheets 900×2400mm and 1200×2400mm (maximum sizes), cut to size
Supplied as finished mounted panels; pricing confirmed per quotation
detail_en.lead: KT board for mounting indoor display graphics, exhibition boards and indoor signage. We supply finished panels — your graphic printed, mounted and trimmed — rather than blank board alone. 5mm is the standard thickness; full sheets are 900×2400mm and 1200×2400mm (maximum sizes, cut to your dimensions). 10mm board is currently produced only at our partner factory in Haiyan, Zhejiang, for the Jiangsu-Zhejiang-Shanghai-Anhui region.

detail_zh.artwork: 请提供印刷文件、成品尺寸、数量、板材厚度要求及目的地。生产前可核对文件尺寸和出血设置。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供板材厚度、尺寸、数量、印刷与裱贴要求、包装要求及收货国家/地区。
detail_zh.caveat: 整板尺寸为最大尺寸，成品按画面尺寸裁切。10mm 目前仅江浙沪皖海盐工厂可供，下单前请先确认产地与时效。密度、起订量与价格本页未列，按每笔订单的实际规格确认，询价时请注明所需规格。需要发票可代开，确认订单时说明即可。KT板定位为室内展示材料，长期户外使用的适用性需结合具体环境另行确认。
delivery: 西安同城（以确认下单时间为准）：11:00 前下单当天下午送达，19:00 前次日中午前送达，19:00 后次日下午送达
三环内必达，三环外多数郊区可达；自有封闭式面包车专送，整板不裁切、送货上门
江浙沪皖由浙江嘉兴海盐合作工厂发货；其他地区时效按订单确认
标准包装：平张叠放包装；具体包装形式可按订单确认
highlights: 表面平整，适合印刷画面裱贴
轻质硬质板材，便于搬运与安装
常用 5mm；整板 90×240cm 与 120×240cm（最大尺寸），可按需裁切
供裱好画面的成品板；价格按询价确认
detail_zh.lead: KT板用于室内展示画面裱贴、展览展示板及室内标识。我们供的是裱好画面的成品板：文件发来，印刷、裱贴、裁切做好再交付。常用厚度 5mm，整板 90×240cm 与 120×240cm（最大尺寸，可按需裁切）；10mm 目前只有江浙沪皖的海盐工厂能供。

seo_description_en: Wholesale KT board (PVC foam board) sheets for poster mounting, exhibition boards and indoor signs. Thickness, sheet sizes and pricing are confirmed per quotation. Enquire about bulk orders and international shipping.
seo_description_zh: KT板定制与批发：常用 5mm 厚度，板材 90×240cm、120×240cm 整板供应，可按尺寸裁切，画面裱贴平整。面向广告公司与制作商，西安同城专车配送、最快当天下午达，全国可发。规格与价格按询价确认。
